# Coverage and depth

| Capability | Owner / depth | Native path / limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin/runner/ABI/config/loading | platform-config; selected substantive implementations, installed pure signatures, strict syntax support | pure config/default tests; Apple registration/artifacts/models blocked |
| Physical KV capacity vs residency, offload tiers/transfer/reuse/sleep | cache-lifecycle; owner/consumer chain and falsifying assertions, dense-only byte ledger | native backing-byte and page lifecycle blocked |
| Spec pairing/GDN state, deferred ownership/GQA routing/benchmark boundaries | qualification; selected substantive gates, diagnostics and offline accounting | native parity/dispatch/model/service blocked |
| Formats/multimodal/quantization/MoE | root scope map plus selected guards only | deep kernel/payload/quality gaps |
| DFlash/DSpark/diffusion/STT/pooling/LoRA/PP/DP | named long-tail boundaries | detailed operating/runtime qualification excluded |

Rubric: every selected primary route has concrete inputs, invariants, steps, safe helper/schema, local references, failure/recovery and explicit stop evidence. Source-defined unsupported is distinguished from supported-but-unverified.
